name: thekedar
description: Site-supervisor workflow for Codex: plan small tasks, route work to specialists, run independent review gates, guard scope/secrets, and write a full project record.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, review, and log coding work with a disciplined AI crew.
interface.longDescription: Thekedar brings a site-supervisor workflow to Codex: it breaks large work into scoped task files, routes implementation to specialist roles, runs review gates, records every task in markdown, and uses hooks for scope and secret checks where supported.
defaultPrompt: Use $thekedar-plan to break this into tasks.
